messages:
tia.design: ok folks 1 — i iterated on the latency dashboard mock. key decision: put sampling affordance inline under the heatmap scrubber (single tap) or hide it in the kebab menu to keep the compact bar minimal. throwing both sketches in the thread.

omar.engineering: inline wins for discoverability. users constantly ask where sampling is. downside: in compact mode it pushes the scrubber and can overlap the time-range chips at very narrow widths.

rex.pm: from interviews, devs want quick access but were confused by previous language around sampling. they thought enabling sampling changed metrics. we must make the distinction super explicit in UI copy.

tia.design: agreed. proposed short help line under the control: "Sampling only reduces visual points; metrics remain computed on full data unless you enable "Lower metrics precision"." also a longer explanation in a help panel.

ana.a11y: tiny correction: consistency matters. use the exact switch label "Lower metrics precision" everywhere. for the inline control, add aria-label="Open sampling options for Heatmap" and ensure the help text id is linked via aria-describedby. avoid relying on color alone to show active state; include a textual indicator.

omar.engineering: backend constraints: we currently store dashboard-level sampling only. supporting chart-level will need prefs schema bump and migration. i can prototype chart-scoped in the UI and persist to local state while we plan the migration. perf note: reading per-chart prefs adds ~20ms in our render path in the prototype.

tia.design: proposal: keep global sampling toggle in the toolbar (default behavior) and show a small inline funnel icon that opens a compact popover for chart-specific overrides. that keeps default simple and provides discoverability. popover content: On/Off, slider (5-100), breadcrumb "Applies to: Heatmap", short help copy, button link to docs.

rex.pm: love hybrid. microcopy suggestion for short help: "Sampling thins visual points to improve responsiveness. Metrics (p50/p95) remain full-accuracy unless 'Lower metrics precision' is enabled." this is slightly shorter than previous.

ana.a11y: for the slider add `aria-valuemin="5"`, `aria-valuemax="100"`, `aria-valuenow` reflecting current value and `aria-live="polite"` so screen readers announce changes. ensure popover is reachable via keyboard and closes on Escape, returning focus to the funnel icon. tap targets >=44px. contrast: the p95 pill on dark should use #a48ff8 or include 1px white outline for AA.

omar.engineering: i'll expose `--p95-badge-color` variable and switch to #a48ff8 by default. also will throttle slider updates with rAF to avoid repaint storms.

tia.design: i'll update mocks: compact hybrid with funnel popover, help copy short, breadcrumb and textual state. added inline screenshot: https://tiny.redwood/heatmap-funnel-v2.

rex.pm: telemetry checklist: `sampling.opened`, `sampling.toggled`, `sampling.rate_changed`, `sampling.scope` (global|chart), and `sampling.help_clicked`. gate per-chart persistence behind `feature:per_chart_sampling` and roll out to canary orgs.

omar.engineering: done. will implement UI + local state, add telemetry, and feature flag. will run perf bench.

tia.design: thanks. i'll update the component spec and accessibility checklist and follow up with a short writeup for docs. tagging design-bot to create follow-up. :thumbsup:

design-bot: created ticket #4410 "Hybrid inline funnel + toolbar toggle for sampling, with a11y checklist" assigned to omar.engineering, due 2024-07-12.
